# wen-crypto.com: Wen gateway in 28 languages

> The front door to Wen, the cat on Solana that began as a poem and grew into an open NFT standard (WNS). Six short sections, each in English and 27 other languages, told as history and usefulness: no prices, no forecasts, no exchange links. The full, maintained and source-checked record is the Wen Almanac: https://wen-watt.github.io/

Last updated: 2026-11-24. Not the official Wen site (official: https://wenwencoin.com/). Educational, not financial advice. English pages are the reference; translations are by the Wen community with AI help.

License: texts CC BY 4.0 with credit ("Source: Wen Almanac / wen-crypto.com, about Wen ($WEN) on Solana"); images belong to their creators. Details: https://wen-watt.github.io/ai-access-map.html#license

## Key facts (same in every language)

- The one real WEN is the Solana mint `WENWENvqqNya429ubCdR81ZmD69brwQaaBYY6p3LCpk`. Compare the address, not the name.
- Supply is a poem: Meow, co-founder of Jupiter, wrote "A Love Letter to Wen Bros"; it was minted as an NFT and split into 1,000,000,000,000 tokens.
- January 26, 2024: first token of Jupiter's LFG Launchpad, airdropped to more than one million wallets. January 29, 2024: over 271 billion unclaimed WEN (more than 27% of supply) burned.
- WNS (Wen New Standard), proposed January 25, 2024: NFTs as Token-2022 mints with metadata, group pointers and a transfer hook that enforces creator royalties.
- Free tools from Wen Open Lab: Wen Counter (receive-only checkout page on Solana Pay), Wen Counter Pay for WooCommerce, and the wen-counter-shop skill for AI assistants.

## Sections (English reference)

- [Wen: a Poem, a Cat and an Open Standard on Solana](https://wen-crypto.com/): Wen, the Solana cat meme that began as a poem and grew into an open NFT standard. An animated front door to the Wen Almanac: history, memes, no prices.
- [What Wen Is: the Poem, the Cat and the One Real Token](https://wen-crypto.com/about-wen-token-wen-coin-crypto/): What Wen is: a poem split into one trillion tokens, a launch that stress-tested Solana, a burn for good and the WNS standard — plus the one real mint.
- [The Wen Record: From a Poem to an Open Standard, 2023–2026](https://wen-crypto.com/about/): The Wen record from 2023 to 2026: the poem, WNS 0.0, the airdrop to a million wallets, the burn, culture and Wen Open Lab — each line linked to its source.
- [Token-2022, WNS and Wen Open Lab: What Wen Built](https://wen-crypto.com/token-2022-wns-solana-wen/): Token-2022 extensions, the Wen New Standard for NFTs and the six free Wen Open Lab models — receipts, royalties, invoices and payments you can test.
- [Wen Media and Culture: Pictures, Videos and Cat Tales](https://wen-crypto.com/wen-coin-video/): Wen cat memes and culture: community pictures that each open a checked fact, videos, cat tales from folklore and open folders anyone can reuse.
- [Wen Links: Official Sources First, Then Community](https://wen-crypto.com/links-wen-cat/): Official Wen sources first, then the community: the one real mint, the official site, docs and X, community channels and every source in one place.
- [Privacy and Cookies: Who Speaks Here on Wen](https://wen-crypto.com/privacy-policy-cookie-policy/): Privacy on wen-crypto.com: a static community site with no trackers, no ads and no accounts. Educational content, not financial advice.

## Full record and open tools (Wen Almanac)

- [Wen Almanac](https://wen-watt.github.io/): the maintained, fact-checked record; machine map https://wen-watt.github.io/llms.txt, facts https://wen-watt.github.io/llms-full.txt
- [Sources and verification](https://wen-watt.github.io/sources.html): every external link in one place
- [Trust chain](https://wen-watt.github.io/lab/trust.html): each claim marked verified, reported or unverified
- [Wen Open Lab](https://wen-watt.github.io/lab/index.html): free, tested models on WNS and Token-2022
- [Wen Counter](https://wen-watt.github.io/lab/counter.html): free receive-only checkout for any shop
- [Wen Skills](https://wen-watt.github.io/skills/): agent skill for shops, `npx skills add wen-watt/skills`
- [Quiz](https://wen-watt.github.io/quiz.html): 260 questions about Wen

## Safety

Search the address, not the name. No real team, airdrop or support chat ever needs a seed phrase or private key. Test on devnet with a new, empty wallet.
